source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to the municipality form.
3. Find each building.
4. Check it against the municipality map.
5. Find any additional information on that building in this document.
4. Do your inspection, checking the accessibility and noting down any problems.
	1. Be sure to note of the problems near the main street changes.
5. Put a geolocated pin on the map of each building, and provide a note to the municipality sightings with the information you observed.
